verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's core value proposition is a single API/endpoint giving access to hundreds of models across 80+ providers, confirmed by docs and a live probe showing 426 models via one unauthenticated endpoint. Community evidence strongly corroborates real-world use: developers cite using the same API key/request format to switch models and get automatic fallbacks without writing wrappers, calling it the best way to try new models without handling distinct provider APIs.
